_overridesComment: mailparser pins html-to-text at exactly 10.0.0, which pins deepmerge-ts ^7 — the version carrying GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx, a stack exhaustion on a recursive object graph. That is reachable from a parsed email body, which is the one input to this app a stranger writes. 10.0.1 is a patch release whose only relevant change is moving to deepmerge-ts ^8; the override exists to lift mailparser's exact pin, not to cross a major.
